memory_update.text: APD should be retained as the US-listed WF6 reference anchor, but not as the primary underfollowed candidate because it is a large diversified industrial-gas company.

ALM is the most direct US-listed Western tungsten upstream candidate found in this pass, but it should be tagged as upstream optionality until APT conversion/offtake and non-China processing access are verified.

KMT fits the underfollowed small/mid-cap lane as a tungsten-carbide tooling and powders user/recycler; its exposure may be positive or negative depending on pass-through pricing and scrap availability.

UCTT is a second-order semiconductor gas-delivery infrastructure candidate; relevance depends on whether WF6 scarcity and purity/handling constraints drive subsystem demand rather than simply constraining fab utilization.

No US-listed pure-play APT processor or pure-play WF6 producer was confirmed in this pass. Next layer should search OTC ADRs and foreign ordinary listings for Stella Chemifa, Daikin, SK Specialty/SK Inc., Merck KGaA, Linde, Air Liquide, Kanto Denka and other specialty-gas producers, while keeping them separate from US-listed candidates.

node: Tungsten APT intermediate processing and WF6 semiconductor gas
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the tungsten APT/WF6 chokepoint. The cleanest direct public-market reference is Air Products, which has disclosed WF6 production capacity for semiconductor customers, but it is too large and diversified for the underfollowed lane. The discovery lane is more interesting in three places: Almonty as a US-listed Western tungsten concentrate producer whose value depends on whether non-China APT conversion can be secured; Kennametal as a tungsten-carbide tooling and powders user/recycler that could face input stress or pricing power; and Ultra Clean as a second-order semiconductor gas-delivery infrastructure supplier exposed to the handling, purity and tool-integration requirements of specialty gases such as WF6. None of the underfollowed names is yet proven to control APT or WF6 capacity; they should enter Layer 1B as candidates requiring verification rather than as confirmed chokepoint owners.
